costume.name: Silent Film Star
costume.description: A black top hat, ivory shirt and charcoal waistcoat pair with pale stage makeup for a walking silent movie.
costume.alt: Black top hat, ivory collared shirt, charcoal waistcoat, high-waisted black trousers and pale stage makeup, with own black shoes.

pieces.name: Black top hat
pieces.styleNotes: Use a tall black crown and curved brim. The reference red hat band is a small optional ribbon addition; these hats have black bands.

matches.reason: Black structured wool felt, mid-rise crown, grosgrain band and leather sweatband; unlined. Only M is currently available at $81.95. Shorter crown than the reference; red ribbon is not included.

Masquerade black satin-style costume top hat in 100% polyester. Merchant specifies one size fits most and dimensions 14 inches high by 10 inches wide, but does not give head circumference. Its feed confirms availability. A lighter costume hat rather than wool felt; check fit before ordering.
Black 100% wool felt, 7-inch crown, 2-inch curled brim and 2-inch grosgrain band with flat side bow; unlined. Only L and XL currently available. No red ribbon included.

pieces.name: Cream collared shirt
pieces.styleNotes: A light cream or ivory shirt under the open flight jacket. A simple point collar and visible button front preserve the look.
queries: mens cream ivory collared cotton shirt

matches.reason: Ivory 100% cotton long-sleeve shirt, point collar, gathered yokes and a broad two-row button placket. Fuller period cut and paired buttons differ from the simple image shirt. Current feed confirms S, L, XL, 2X and 3X at $69.95; M and 4X unavailable. Shirt only, trousers in photo are excluded.

Cream/off-white 100% cotton shirt with point collar and full button front. Short sleeves differ from the image, but sit under the jacket. Merchant variant endpoint /remote/v1/product-attributes/2106 confirms S (attribute 4755) and M (4758) in stock at $18.95; larger available sizes cost $19.95 and are excluded. Shirt only.

Cream 100% cotton long-sleeve button-down with one chest pocket, made in USA. Shorter untucked-length cut differs from the long image shirt. Only S and XL are currently available at $225; XS, M and L are sold out. Product-only styling items are not included.

pieces.name: Charcoal waistcoat
pieces.styleNotes: A fitted dark button-front waistcoat over the blouse. Gray tweed and black brocade approximate charcoal; the blouse is bought separately.
queries: charcoal women waistcoat Victorian brocade vest

matches.reason: Gray tweed women’s vest with notched lapels, five buttons, faux pockets and adjustable back belt. 100% polyester with satin acetate back, fully lined. Gray tweed is lighter and less ornate than the reference’s charcoal brocade. Vest only; blouse and skirt are separate. S, M, L, XL, 2X and 3X are available at USD64.95 in the live feed; use the live size selector, as description text stops at 2X. Dispatch time unstated.

Black Victorian damask brocade vest, 65% cotton/35% polyester, lined in black polyester sateen. Collarless V neck with three metal buttons and adjustable back buckle. Men’s slim cut differs from the reference’s shaped women’s charcoal lapel vest; measure chest before selecting. Vest only. All S–5XL variants are available at USD32.45. Listing says custom made; production/dispatch time is not specified.

Black tone-on-tone brocade women’s vest with lapels, covered buttons, two welt pockets and an adjustable buckle back. 100% polyester microfiber front with acetate backing, fully lined. Close in ornate fitted shape, but black rather than charcoal and no decorative chain. Vest only. All XS–2X variants available. Dispatch time unstated.

pieces.name: Black high-waisted trousers
pieces.styleNotes: Use a high waist and straight black trouser leg that can tuck into tall boots. The reference double rows of gold buttons are decorative and not present on every option. The highest-price trousers are currently available only in size 46. Use the merchant natural-waist measurement guidance rather than converting modern jeans sizes.

matches.reason: Black 100% brushed cotton, high waist, button-front fly, suspender buttons and back buckle. Softer dress-style finish than canvas; buttons are black rather than gold. 36-inch inseam; local hemming may be needed. Size 30 is unavailable and excluded. Suspenders pictured are sold separately.

Black 100% cotton canvas work trousers with high waist, button fly, suspender buttons and adjustable back strap. More casual matte fabric than the reference dress trousers. 36-inch inseam may need local hemming. Only the enumerated sizes are currently available; 34 and 38 are excluded. Suspenders sold separately.

Black 100% cotton twill reproduction with broad buttoned fall front, hidden button fly, internal suspender buttons and adjustable back buckle; unlined. Only size 46 available at $86.95. The front button arrangement approximates the reference but uses black buttons, not gold.

pieces.name: White stage makeup
pieces.styleNotes: Three in-stock jar volumes of the same Ben Nye formula, not three different colors. Smallest available 1.75 oz is sufficient for one event. Makeup base only; powder/applicator and black detailing are not included. White gloves and a bow tie in the styling reference are optional owned accessories, not included in this catalog.

matches.reason: Ben Nye white stage cream, 1.75 oz jar; base makeup only. Setting powder, applicators and black details are separate supplies. Follow manufacturer use/removal directions. Public merchant variant feed confirms this exact USD price and available variant on the research date.

Ben Nye white stage cream, 3 oz jar of the same formula; more product rather than a different effect. Base only, no applicator or setting powder. Public merchant variant feed confirms this exact USD price and available variant on the research date.

Ben Nye white stage cream, large 8 oz jar of the same formula. Excess for one event; shared theatrical supply option, no extra tools. Public merchant variant feed confirms this exact USD price and available variant on the research date.
